instrument_name: Robinhood Markets, Inc. Class A common stock
watchlist_reason: Reviewed after the 2026-07-30 lower-Bollinger transition; valuation, trading and crypto cyclicality, credit, regulation, concentration, product execution, debt and dilution require monitoring.
research_summary: Rapid asset, deposit, customer and revenue growth supports the platform thesis, but cyclicality, one-off earnings, higher costs and a bounded base value below the current mark make the lower-band alert a risk signal rather than an entry.
